shortDescription: Join a DNS server to an existing cluster as a Secondary node

options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: ignore_certificate_errors
options.description: Set to true only when you know the Primary node uses a self-signed TLS certificate and is on a private network.

options.name: primary_node_ip_address
options.description: The IP address of the Primary node in the cluster. When unspecified, the domain name in the Primary node URL will be resolved and used.

options.name: primary_node_password
options.description: The password of the administrator user.

options.name: primary_node_totp
options.description: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app for the administrator user. Only required if the user has 2FA enabled.

options.name: primary_node_url
options.description: The web service HTTPS URL of the Primary node in the cluster.

options.name: primary_node_username
options.description: The username of an administrator on the Primary node in the cluster.

options.name: secondary_node_ip_addresses
options.description: The static IP address(es) of this DNS server that will be accessible by all other nodes in the cluster. Accepts a list of IP addresses for nodes with multiple network interfaces. When multiple IPs are provided, they will be used for cluster communication.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests.
